WITH gender_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.gender,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as order_count
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    GROUP BY c.gender
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(order_count) as total_orders,
        COUNT(*) as num_genders,
        SUM(order_count) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as avg_share
    FROM gender_counts
)
SELECT 
    gc.gender,
    gc.order_count,
    gc.order_count * 1.0 / t.total_orders as share,
    (gc.order_count * 1.0 / t.total_orders) - t.avg_share as deviation_above_average
FROM gender_counts gc
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE gc.order_count * 1.0 / t.total_orders > t.avg_share
ORDER BY gc.gender
